Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.07 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Given a Solana transaction signature, returns a decoded breakdown: fee payer, programs invoked (Jupiter, Raydium, Pump.fun, SPL Token, etc.), SPL token balance changes with deltas, transaction fee in SOL and USD, block time, and a one-sentence human-readable summary. Uses public Solana mainnet RPC — no API key required. $0.07/call.
name: solana-tx-explainer

fee_payer.description: Address that paid the transaction fee.

fee_usd.description: Transaction fee in USD (null if SOL price unavailable).

programs.description: Unique programs invoked (outer + inner instructions), resolved to human-readable names.

summary.description: One-sentence human-readable explanation of what this transaction did.

token_changes.description: SPL token balance changes for all affected token accounts.

delta.description: Token amount change (positive = received, negative = sent).
